intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for TelemetryConfiguration. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Composition wiring unit (@Configuration + @EnableConfigurationProperties(TelemetryProperties.class)) in package com.blackboard.telemetry.shared.config, under the single boot class in base package com.blackboard.telemetry (which is an ancestor of every component and test package, so no scan directive is needed). It is the ONE registration mechanism for exactly these types: Clock (UTC system clock), TelemetryProperties (via @EnableConfigurationProperties), TelemetryMeters, AuditTrail (R2dbcAuditTrail), ValidatedSampleStream (InMemoryValidatedSampleStream), TelemetryHistoryRepository (R2dbcTelemetryHistoryRepository), HistoryEventPublisher (InMemoryHistoryEventPublisher), IngestPacketService, ReorderHistoryService, PipelineSubscriber; those classes carry no stereotype annotations. MeterRegistry and DatabaseClient are provided by the Spring Boot actuator and R2DBC auto-configuration. IngestionController and CorrelationWebFilter self-register and are NOT produced here. Routing duty: PipelineSubscriber places ReorderHistoryService on the validated-stream path, IngestionController places IngestPacketService on the request path. Values come from application.yml only. Boot test: @SpringBootTest with the test profile (embedded H2 + the real migrations) asserts every type above resolves exactly once from the context, the SmartLifecycle PipelineSubscriber isRunning, and the context boots with no external service.

methods.signature: IngestPacketService ingestPacketService(TelemetryProperties properties, ValidatedSampleStream stream, AuditTrail auditTrail, TelemetryMeters meters, Clock clock)

ReorderHistoryService reorderHistoryService(TelemetryHistoryRepository repository, HistoryEventPublisher publisher, AuditTrail auditTrail, TelemetryMeters meters, TelemetryProperties properties, Clock clock)
